mapper.select: select id,code,name,seq_no as seqNo,price,status from sms_registration_rank where status=1 order by seq_no,id
select id,code,cat_id as catId,name,type,status from sms_dept where status is null or status=1 order by id
select id,name,dept_id as deptId from sms_staff where dept_id=#{deptId} order by name

select distinct s.id,s.name,s.dept_id as deptId from sms_skd sk left join sms_staff s on sk.staff_id=s.id where sk.dept_id=#{deptId} and sk.date >= #{start} and sk.date < #{end} and sk.status=1 and sk.remain>0 and sk.noon=#{noon} order by s.name
select price from sms_registration_rank where id=#{rankId} and status=1

select id,registration_id as registrationId,item_type as itemType,source_id as sourceId,item_name as itemName,amount,paid_amount as paidAmount,status,create_time as createTime,update_time as updateTime from bms_payable_item where registration_id=#{registrationId} order by id
select id from bms_payable_item where registration_id=#{registrationId} and status!=1
select count(1) from bms_payable_item where registration_id=#{registrationId} and status!=1
mapper.update: update dms_registration set bind_status=#{bindStatus} where id=#{registrationId}
mapper.select:
select count(1) from dms_registration dr left join pms_patient p on dr.patient_id=p.id
where p.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.medical_record_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
mapper.update: update bms_payable_item set paid_amount=0,status=0,update_time=now() where registration_id=#{registrationId}
